name: Columbia Gas Transmission Hardy Storage Project loops

values.OtherEnglishNames: CGT Hardy Storage Pipeline Expansion; Hardy Transmission Project
values.Parent: TC Energy Corp [60.00%]; Global Infrastructure Partners [40.00%]

researcher_notes: Columbia Gas Transmission built three new 24-inch loops (about 30.2 mi) on its WB-2-VA line in Shenandoah, Rockingham, Page and Greene Counties, Virginia, plus a 2.6 mi 14-inch loop in Louisa County, for the Hardy Storage project. FERC environmental assessment notice of August 2005 (Federal Register E5-4364) states this. The EIA August 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 441, lists 'CGT Hardy Storage Pipeline Expansion', Completed April 2007, 33.5 mi, 24 in, 175 MMcf/d incremental, cost 55 million USD, docket CP05-144. 33.5 mi staged as EIA states it; EA components sum to 32.8 mi. EIA lists states as VA,MD but the EA shows Virginia only; Maryland not confirmed. Not a match to P0169, which is the whole-system row; other Columbia expansions are separate rows (P2516, P3188). Hardy LLC's own 36.8 mi West Virginia line (EIA row 438, CGT Hardy Storage Lateral) is a separate candidate. Two sources but EIA and the EA both trace to the same FERC docket, so independence is limited. Owner and Parent copied from existing sibling rows P2516/P3188. Start location: exact end points of the loops not found in sources read; county level only. No route found, route not researched beyond that. Meets add-threshold: sponsor, counties, completed project, new pipe above 25 km (33.5 mi = about 54 km).
